propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionSystemTypeVentilation
propertySets.definition:
This property set is used to define the general characteristics of the duct design parameters within a system.
HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 2.0.  Renamed from Pset_DuctDesignCriteria in IFC4.

properties.name: DesignName
properties.definition: A name for the design values.

properties.name: DuctSizingMethod
properties.definition: Enumeration that identifies the methodology to be used to size system components.

properties.name: PressureClass
properties.definition:
Nominal pressure rating of the object.

Nominal pressure rating of the system components.

properties.name: LeakageClass
properties.definition: Nominal leakage rating for the system components.

properties.name: FrictionLoss
properties.definition: The pressure loss due to friction per unit length. (Data type = PressureMeasure/LengthMeasure)

properties.name: DuctSealant
properties.definition: Type of sealant used on the duct and fittings.

properties.name: MaximumVelocity
properties.definition: The maximum design velocity of the air in the duct or fitting.

properties.name: MinimumHeight
properties.definition: The minimum duct height for rectangular, oval or round duct.

properties.name: MinimumWidth
properties.definition: The minimum duct width for oval or rectangular duct.
